verdict.rationale: OpenHands has a public GitHub repository (github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands), and first-party docs explicitly refer to an "OpenHands Open Source" plan and an "open-source" Agent Canvas client, so the core of the story is delivered. However, the specific license is never named, and the separate Enterprise "licensed self-hosting" offering suggests some components may sit outside the open license. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license identified in evidence, clarity on which components are open versus commercially licensed, and independent corroboration.
